messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  we flagged three partner-related deals that look time-sensitive. Can each owner drop a one-line status + the single next action so exec can triage? I'll watch here for 20m.

dylan: Sales TL;DR:
- ArdentHealth: $360k ARR, blocker = delayed SOC2 evidence + partner scheduling. Next action: send SOC bundle + request CISO sync. Owner: dylan.

keisha: Partner note (Ardent goes through our SI partner Helio): Helio needs a 48h engineering wedge to validate routing. They asked for a named contact. If approved, I'll be the contact.

owen: Product impact: wedge + SOC push = ~1 sprint hit to routing perf work. If leadership chooses revenue-protection, we should reassign two engineers this sprint.

dylan: Next deal: NovaWorks (renewal) $140k ARR, blocker = procurement PO lag. Next action: send procurement packet + procurement intro. Owner: dylan.

keisha: Third: BlueMount via ChannelX: $80k ARR, blocker = reseller margin language. Next action: draft reseller addendum + offer onboarding credit. Owner: keisha.

sync-bot: Created calendar: "Partner triage - Ardent/NovaWorks/BlueMount"  standup tomorrow 09:15 PST. Invitees: maria, dylan, keisha, owen. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/2134500000

maria: Thanks  decision for leadership: approve 48h wedge + SOC push (reassign engs) or keep roadmap. If any deal >$250k at risk mark high.

dylan: Ardent is >$250k  mark high. I'll escalate to exec if wedge not approved before standup.

keisha: I'll draft the reseller addendum and the onboarding credit template and post links here.

owen: I'll prepare a short tradeoff slide (cost vs. churn risk) for the standup.

maria: Great. Please post links and escalate any blockers here. Closing in 20m.
